domain: supply-chain control tower (merge-time governance of AI-produced changes)
gold_note: Gold dispositions are DESIGNED ground truth: each PR was constructed so that one disposition is defensible on the written rulebook and the seeded jurisprudence, and the reason is recorded in the corpus 'why' field. They are not expert labels. Phase 2 replaces this field with adjudicated expert consensus and reports kappa; until then every agreement number computed against these labels is a pipeline check, not a finding.

classes.covered: a seeded precedent controls on the merits
classes.distinguishable: a seeded precedent is retrieved but its premise is absent
classes.novel: nothing in the store reaches the facts
classes.tie: equal-authority conflicting precedent; no key separates them
classes.floor_adjacent: framed as ordinary, but the effect trips a floor
classes.floor_first: an absolute and an ordinary provision are engaged together
classes.control_plane: the change targets the rulebook itself (A3)
classes.lapsed_trap: a lapsed or overruled acceptance would resolve it if relied on
classes.multi_provision: two ordinary provisions engaged at once
classes.self_asserted: a material fact is claimed by the author, not observed
classes.clean: the provision is engaged and satisfied
